The rules rely only on the sensors, flags and obstacle phase, so they hold for any grid size or layout.

1. **Progress first.** The agent prefers moves that are `closer` to the next unreached goal, since `closer` follows shortest free paths around static obstacles. `toward` is a fallback when `closer` is not available.

  {"condition": "closer & !obstacle & !early", "action": "any"},

  {"condition": "!obstacle & !early", "action": "any"},
